messages: Support check failed because the claim that the North Carolina Supreme Court struck down the legislature’s congressional map as an *impermissible partisan gerrymander* is not directly supported by the supplied evidence; the evidence only states the map was struck down, without specifying the reason.
Overstatement check failed because the same claim adds the qualifier “impermissible partisan gerrymander,” which goes beyond what the evidence confirms, constituting an overstatement.
